      "id": "overview"

      <li parentName="ul">{`Set your own image/video as a video background.`}</li>

    <p>{`The Avatar API is an asynchronous API. The API returns a job ID immediately after the request is submitted. The job status can be checked using the GET Result API.`}</p>

    <h3 {...{

        "mediaType": "text/plain",

    },
    "voiceId": "<voice_ID>",

    "output": {
        "mediaType": "video/mp4"
    }
}'
`}</code></pre>
